description.value: A stolen ration card, a half-remembered accent, a Combine patch sewn on crooked — it's enough if you sell it right. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Impersonate a specific faction member or role you've directly observed within the last day.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 is conditioned on 'a specific faction member or role you've directly observed within the last day' -- an unverifiable narrative/time-based fact with no roll option. Shipping it unconditionally would overstate the card by granting it against any Impersonate check, not just the qualifying one.
